newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INTERNATIO-M BUYS DUTCH AUTOMATION FIRM.
newsitem.headline: INTERNATIO-M BUYS DUTCH AUTOMATION FIRM.

text.p: Transport and trading company Internatio-Mueller NV said on Thursday it had agreed to buy Dutch automation firm Turnkiek Holding BV.
Turnkiek has five units with a total of 150 employees. Joint turnover for the current year is expected to be about 25 million guilders, Internatio said in a statement.
Turnkiek has clients in the petrochemical, chemical and food industry sectors and develops products for traffic infrastructure projects.
Internatio said the unit's products and services were a good addition to those of its technical services division Imtech, of which Turnkiek will become part.
Imtech is one of the largest technical services providers in the Netherlands with about 6,000 employees.
No financial details of the takeover were disclosed.
